lessons.culture: Bargaining is a normal, expected part of shopping in Damascene markets, especially for clothes, souvenirs, and household goods, though not usually in supermarkets with printed prices. A shopper who never tries to lower the price is unusual, and sellers expect the back-and-forth as part of the exchange.
